items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption was up 45% year-over-year through May, tracking above forecasted range, driven by continued strength in stationary storage and improving growth in electric vehicles. Needed supply increases are coming to market slower than demand growth.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Investor Day on Aug 12, 2026 - Slides
items.snippet: 2026E outlook scenarios by LCE price: at $10/kg net sales $4.1-4.3B, at $20/kg $5.7-6.0B, at $30/kg $7.5-7.8B. Includes ~$70-90M unmitigated Middle East supply chain disruption impact.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets said Albemarle will likely benefit from low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, and continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties. RBC has an outperform rating and decreased the price target to $157 from $166.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Sales volumes expected to be in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred on June 9.
